pages.title: Eternal Silence Bow
pages.text: Carries Infinity and Power III. Armor-Piercing Arrows directly remove royal shields. Press R to load ammunition and K to switch between triple-shot and rapid-fire. Rapid fire lasts five seconds and has a 25% chance to incur a five-second cooldown.

pages.title: Armor-Piercing Arrow
pages.text: A hit directly removes a royal shield and ignores Projectile Ward. Breaking a shield this way also ends shield-bound affixes and their material drops. Affixes intended to last for the entity's whole life remain active.

pages.title: Dragon-Breath Bow
pages.text: An Eternal Silence Compound Bow transforms permanently after the End Crystal infusion. Dragon-breath ammunition follows an arrow trajectory and deals 20 base damage on impact. See Special Crafting & Rites for the infusion.

pages.title: Eternal Silence Totem
pages.text: Direct melee hits count twice. Fatal damage consumes one revival, grants 30 seconds of invulnerability, then gives +100% attack speed and +50% attack damage for 15 seconds.$(br2)Five uses are tracked in code. Repairing durability cannot restore them.

pages.title: Rebirth Totem
pages.text: While equipped, it grants +50% attack damage and makes direct melee hits count twice. Fatal damage gives the same 30-second invulnerability and 15-second surge, then begins a 90-second revival cooldown instead of consuming five-use charges.
